extendedText.title: Holland Partner Group Response
extendedText.text:
Hello *******,

Thank you for reaching out. We would like to clarify that the move-out accounting and supporting documentation were completed in accordance with our standard procedures and applicable requirements.

Our records indicate that an itemized move-out statement, along with supporting documentation, was provided. That said, we understand these materials can occasionally be overlooked or misplaced. We are happy to resend the full itemized statement, including supporting photos and documentation used to assess the charges.


Our goal is to ensure full transparency regarding the final accounting. Please confirm the best email address for delivery, and we will promptly send the materials.


Should you have any questions after reviewing the documentation, we are happy to address specific line items and provide any additional clarification needed.

extendedText.title: Customer Response
extendedText.text: Hi, can you confirm then in the state of ********** that itemized receipt is simply cleaning and painting with no further detail? Thats the itemization I received, but even a simple ****** search shows that cleaning is not considered itemized for a move out.

extendedText.title: Holland Partner Group Response
extendedText.text: Thank you for your follow-up. As part of your move-out packet, we provided the receipt and supporting documentation for the charges, which qualifies as the itemized statement for the cleaning and painting referenced. That said, as a courtesy, management has elected to waive the cleaning fee. Your account has been adjusted accordingly, and you will see a new updated balance reflecting this change. Please review the revised balance and let us know if you need a copy of the updated statement or any additional documentation. Were happy to provide it.

items.text: I called Holland via a phone number provided on a email. I called regarding an issue and a lack of communication with the Lydian, one of their apartment complexes in **********, and the Holland representative told me I can reply to the email I received to file a dispute with Holland so I could talk with someone about the issue. I emailed, twice, and called and left a message and they never responded back to me - instead, they sent me to debt collection. Lydian, and subsequently Holland, did not comply with California law regarding security deposits - they never provided an "itemized receipt" (only "cleaning" and "painting" with no further details which in ********** does NOT count as itemized) and they never provided photos of work completed, which is required in California upon request. Very rude people who refuse to communicate and learn about the correct regulations and laws.

extendedText.title: Holland Partner Group Response
extendedText.text:
We're sorry to hear about your experience and appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. Our team responded to and documented each concern you raised, taking multiple steps to address the reported noise issues with your upstairs neighbor. We did not receive any police reports or courtesy patrol documentation to support your claims of vandalism or stalking by another resident; without any verification, we are unable to take further action. 

We understand how frustrating noise concerns can be, which is why we respond promptly and fairly to all residents when these types of complaints are submitted. While lease-termination fees are outlined in the leasing agreement and applied consistently, we do our best to work with residents whenever possible to resolve issues before they reach that point. 

We welcome the opportunity to connect directly and discuss your experience further. Please feel free to contact our management team.

I lived at ************** in ******* ** managed by Holland Partner group. This company is one of the worst ive worked with.
